kernel-tiling.summary: Kernel-side scalar control derives the fixed tile grid and tails.

kernel-block-map.summary: Scalar control maps tileIdx to one GM output slice and creates the L0C view.

gm-to-l1.summary: MTE2 moves the current A/B K-L1 slices from GM into L1 views.

l1-to-l0.summary: MTE1 loads one K-L0 slice into A2/L0A and B2/L0B.

mmad.summary: Cube consumes A2/B2 and initializes or accumulates the FP32 CO1 tile in L0C.

sync-m-fix.summary: M_FIX publishes the final CO1 result to the output path.

l0c-to-gm.summary: The output path copies the completed L0C tile back to the GM C slice.

host-verify.summary: Host waits, copies C from device memory, and invokes result verification.

static constexpr bool transA = false; // Whether to transpose matrix A
static constexpr bool transB = false; // Whether to transpose matrix B

AscendC::Std::conditional_t<transA, AscendC::Te::FrameLayoutFormat<AscendC::Te::ZNLayoutPtn, AscendC::Te::LayoutTraitDefault<T>>, AscendC::Te::FrameLayoutFormat<AscendC::Te::NZLayoutPtn, AscendC::Te::LayoutTraitDefault<T>>>; // Layout for A

AscendC::Std::conditional_t<transB, AscendC::Te::FrameLayoutFormat<AscendC::Te::ZNLayoutPtn, AscendC::Te::LayoutTraitDefault<T>>, AscendC::Te::FrameLayoutFormat<AscendC::Te::NZLayoutPtn, AscendC::Te::LayoutTraitDefault<T>>>; // Layout for B
* @brief Simple kernel example for matrix multiplication on Ascend processors
* @tparam T Data type of matrices (typically float)
* @param aGm Global memory address of input matrix A (size m×k)
* @param bGm Global memory address of input matrix B (size k×n)
* @param cGm Global memory address of output matrix C (size m×n)
* @param m Number of rows in matrix A
* @param k Number of columns in matrix A / rows in matrix B
* @param n Number of columns in matrix B
__global__ __aicore__ void MatmulKernel(GM_ADDR aGm, GM_ADDR bGm, GM_ADDR cGm, uint32_t m, uint32_t k, uint32_t n)
KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_AIC_ONLY); // Specify kernel type as AI Core only
// Initialize tiling parameters for efficient memory hierarchy utilization
uint64_t baseM = 256;             // Base tile size for M dimension in L0
uint64_t baseN = 256;             // Base tile size for N dimension in L0
uint64_t baseK = 256 / sizeof(T); // Base tile size for K dimension in L0
uint64_t kL1 = 1024 / sizeof(T);  // Tile size for K dimension in L1
// Construct GM tensors with ND layout
// Initialize synchronization flags for pipeline control
// Multi-core tile processing loop - distribute tiles across available cores
for (uint64_t tileIdx = curBlockIdx; tileIdx < tileNum; tileIdx += blockNum) {
// Slice GM to L1 - prepare memory pointers for this tile
auto tensorBGmBlock = tensorBgm.Slice(AscendC::Te::MakeCoord(0L, nTileIdx * baseN), AscendC::Te::MakeShape(k, curN));
auto layoutL0C = AscendC::Te::MakeFrameLayout<AscendC::Te::NZLayoutPtn, AscendC::Std::Int<tool::L0C_C0>>(curM, curN); // L0C layout for output
// Process K dimension in multiple L1 tiles
auto curGmBKL1 = (iter0 + 1 == kL1TileNum) ? (k - iter0 * kL1) : kL1;
auto layoutAL1 = AscendC::Te::MakeLayoutAL1<T>{}(curM, curGmAKL1); // Layout for A in L1
AscendC::Te::Copy(copyGM2L1, tensorAL1, tensorAGmTile); // Copy A tile from GM to L1
auto layoutBL1 = AscendC::Te::MakeLayoutBL1<T>{}(curGmBKL1, curN); // Layout for B in L1
AscendC::Te::Copy(copyGM2L1, tensorBL1, tensorBGmTile); // Copy B tile from GM to L1
// Process K dimension in multiple L0 tiles
auto copyL12L0B = AscendC::Te::MakeCopy(AscendC::Te::CopyL12L0B{}); // L1 to L0 copy operation
auto layoutAL0 = AscendC::Te::MakeFrameLayout<AscendC::Te::NZLayoutPtn, AscendC::Te::LayoutTraitDefault<T>>(curM, curKL0);      // NZ layout for A in L0
AscendC::Te::Copy(copyL12L0A, tensorAL0, tensorAL1Tile); // Copy A tile from L1 to L0
auto layoutBL0 = AscendC::Te::MakeFrameLayout<AscendC::Te::ZNLayoutPtn, AscendC::Te::LayoutTraitDefault<T>>(curKL0, curN); // ZN layout for B in L0
AscendC::Te::Copy(copyL12L0B, tensorBL0, tensorBL1Tile); // Copy B tile from L1 to L0
para.cmatrixInitVal = (iter1 == 0 && iter0 == 0); // Initialize C matrix on first iteration
// Copy result from L0C to GM
auto copyL0C2GM = AscendC::Te::MakeCopy(AscendC::Te::CopyL0C2GM{}); // L0C to GM copy operation
AscendC::Te::Copy(copyL0C2GM, tensorCGmBlock, tensorL0C);           // Copy computed tile to global memory
// Final synchronization for all pipeline stages
// Macro for condition checking with error message
std::cerr << "Usage: " << programName << " m k n" << std::endl;
std::cerr << "  m: row of matrix A" << std::endl;
std::cerr << "  k: col of matrix A" << std::endl;
std::cerr << "  n: col of matrix B" << std::endl;
* @param m Output parameter for M dimension
* @param k Output parameter for K dimension
* @param n Output parameter for N dimension
void parseArguments(int argc, char* argv[], int& m, int& k, int& n)
throw std::invalid_argument("ERROR: m k n must be Integer");
throw std::invalid_argument("ERROR: m k n must be positive");
* @brief Main function - host code for matrix multiplication
std::string cmd = "python3 gen_data.py " + std::to_string(m) + " " + std::to_string(k) + " " + std::to_string(n);
ret = aclrtMemcpy(deviceInput, sizeInput, hostInput.data(), sizeInput, ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_DEVICE);
ret = aclrtMemcpy(deviceWeight, sizeWeight, hostWeight.data(), sizeWeight, ACL_MEMCPY_HOST_TO_DEVICE);
uint32_t numBlocks = ascendcPlatform->GetCoreNumAic(); // Number of AI cores
matmul::MatmulKernel<bfloat16_t><<<numBlocks, nullptr, stream>>>(deviceInput, deviceWeight, deviceOutput, m, k, n);
ret = aclrtMemcpy(hostOutput.data(), sizeOutput, deviceOutput, sizeOutput, ACL_MEMCPY_DEVICE_TO_HOST);

// Slice GM to L1 - prepare memory pointers for this tile
auto tensorBGmBlock = tensorBgm.Slice(AscendC::Te::MakeCoord(0L, nTileIdx * baseN), AscendC::Te::MakeShape(k, curN));
auto layoutL0C = AscendC::Te::MakeFrameLayout<AscendC::Te::NZLayoutPtn, AscendC::Std::Int<tool::L0C_C0>>(curM, curN); // L0C layout for output
// Process K dimension in multiple L1 tiles

AscendC::Te::Copy(copyGM2L1, tensorBL1, tensorBGmTile); // Copy B tile from GM to L1
// Process K dimension in multiple L0 tiles

AscendC::Te::Copy(copyL12L0A, tensorAL0, tensorAL1Tile); // Copy A tile from L1 to L0
auto layoutBL0 = AscendC::Te::MakeFrameLayout<AscendC::Te::ZNLayoutPtn, AscendC::Te::LayoutTraitDefault<T>>(curKL0, curN); // ZN layout for B in L0
AscendC::Te::Copy(copyL12L0B, tensorBL0, tensorBL1Tile); // Copy B tile from L1 to L0

tiers.label: GM
tiers.description: A、B 输入和 C 输出的 Global Memory 视图。

tiers.label: L0A
tiers.description: A2 的 Cube 输入 view。

tiers.label: L0B
tiers.description: B2 的 Cube 输入 view。

tiers.description: CO1 的 FP32 累加 view。

stages.label: Host Launch
stages.description: Allocate and launch the BF16 kernel.

stages.label: Kernel Tiling
stages.description: Derive output and reduction tile counts.

stages.label: Block → C tile
stages.description: Map a block to output C tile and L0C view.

stages.label: GM → L1
stages.description: Copy A/B K slices into A1/B1.

stages.label: L0C → GM
stages.description: Write current output tile to GM C.

stages.label: Host Verify
stages.description: Copy output back and run correctness verification.

steps.label: Parse M / K / N
steps.summary: Host 接收运行时 M、K、N，并检查三个维度为正数。

steps.label: Allocate, copy and launch
steps.summary: Host 初始化 ACL、分配 A/B/C Device Memory、完成输入拷贝并启动 MatmulKernel。

steps.label: Derive tile grid
steps.summary: 根据运行时 M/K/N 和 sizeof(T) 派生 M/N 输出网格、L1 K 分片、L0 K 分片和尾块参数。

steps.label: Create GM views and map block
steps.summary: block 从 curBlockIdx 开始步进处理输出 tile，并通过 Slice 建立当前 A、B、C 区域和 L0C 输出视图。

steps.label: Copy GM → L1
steps.summary: 当前输出 tile 的 A、B K slice 通过 CopyGM2L1 写入 L1 的 A1、B1 view。

steps.label: MTE2 → MTE1
steps.summary: GM→L1 完成后 SetFlag/WaitFlag MTE2_MTE1，后续 L1→L0 建立在该依赖上。

steps.label: Copy L1 → L0
steps.summary: 每个 L1 K tile 再拆成 L0 K tile，CopyL12L0A/B 将 A1、B1 送入 L0A、L0B。

steps.label: Mmad initialize / accumulate
steps.summary: 第一次 Mmad 初始化 CO1，后续 Mmad 沿 K 维累加到同一个 L0C view；本案例没有 Bias。

steps.label: M → output path
steps.summary: 当前输出 tile 的 K 归约完成后，SetFlag/WaitFlag M_FIX，允许输出路径读取最终 CO1。

steps.label: Copy L0C → GM
steps.summary: CopyL0C2GM 将当前 CO1 tile 写回 C GM Slice；源码未显式调用名为 Fixpipe 的 API。

steps.label: Synchronize and verify
steps.summary: Host 等待 stream、回拷 C、运行 BF16 correctness 校验并释放 ACL 资源。

puzzles.prompt: For M=1024 and baseM=256, how many M output tiles exist?
For BF16 K=2048, how many L1 and L0 K tiles exist?
Is B1 NZ → B2 ZN a mathematical transpose?
puzzles.answer: No; it is a layout/storage preparation.
puzzles.explanation: The source changes the local layout view; the Code Recovery model must not claim a mathematical transpose without additional evidence.

puzzles.prompt: Which source API writes L0C to GM C?
puzzles.explanation: The sample calls CopyL0C2GM; a separate explicit Fixpipe call is not present in main.asc.
